text:
Aisha: Quick sync — I'm proposing a small 'quota shim' for the rerank endpoint. It enforces a soft cap of token-units per-request and emits a telemetry tag when a request is downsampled. Also want to add a hint field for model_affinity so console can surface preferred models for a tenant. Thoughts?
Ben: Sounds useful. Is the shim enforced upstream (gateway) or inside reranker? We need to avoid double-counting tokens.
Aisha: Inside reranker runtime ideally. Gateway already does rough rate limits; shim is about max effective scoring units per-call and graceful degradation.
Carlos: Two concerns: 1) scoring format needs to carry a per-candidate cost so aggregates are accurate. 2) model_affinity hint changes routing — we should make it advisory only, not authoritative.
Dana: For console UX, an explicit field would let us show "Preferred models" and a projection of spend if tenant switches affinity. Prefer not to expose raw token counts to PMs — use normalized scoring-units.
Eve: We should emit 3 telemetry counters: scoring_units_requested, scoring_units_charged, scoring_units_shimmed. That makes regressions easy to track. Also add a sample of top-k candidates for eval traces (PII scrubbed).
Carlos: +1 on counters. For the scoring contract, propose we add to the rerank payload:
```
{
  "candidates": [{"id": "c1", "payload": "..."}],
  "scoring_units_limit": 500,  // optional, per-request hint
  "model_affinity": "mix-04-a" // optional advisory string
}
```
This keeps it backward-compatible (fields optional).
Ben: What happens when scoring_units_limit < cost to score top candidates? Do we return partial scores or a graceful error? My vote: partial scoring + deterministic truncation order (client-defined priority if provided).
Aisha: Agree with partial scoring and deterministic truncation. We'll return an envelope with metadata showing which candidates were skipped due to shim and a boolean `partial=true`. Example response snippet:
```
{
  "partial": true,
  "skipped_reason": "quota_shim",
  "scores": [{"id":"c2","score":0.89}]
}
```
Dana: For console, show a collapsed "partial result" badge and link to a detailed trace (shows which candidates skipped and estimated token savings). Also let users simulate "what if" by toggling scoring_units_limit in the console.
Eve: On rollouts: we should canary the shim for 10% of traffic for 48h and monitor scoring_units_shimmed ratio + error rate + latency. I can add a dashboard tile for that.
rollout-bot: Canary deploy started: reranker-shim v0.1 -> 10% traffic at 2024-07-31T14:00Z
Carlos: Small note — model_affinity strings need a registry to avoid typos. Maybe validate against model catalog but allow unknown values (log warning).
Ben: Telemetry schema needs to track model_affinity in traces (not as high-cardinality metric). Use tag on traces and sample-based counters.
Aisha: OK action items: (1) Carlos: propose minimal proto for scoring_units accounting + envelope changes, (2) Dana: wire up console preview for "partial" badge and simulator, (3) Eve: dashboard tiles + canary alerts, (4) Ben: add tracing tags & sampling guidance. We'll iterate. :thumbsup:
Dana: I'll mock the console card this afternoon and post screenshots.
Eve: Adding alert: if scoring_units_shimmed / scoring_units_requested > 0.2 for canary group, rollback.
Aisha: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll create an RFC and attach the proto example, and link here when done.
Ben: Nice, thanks.
rollout-bot: Canary deploy reached 10% traffic (checks passed).
